title: Eui
summary: Raleigh names Eui in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Eui, one of the five Midianite dukes. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter V, §. IX, sig. 206a
